closest.name: Perinthalmanna
closest.runner: K. P. M. Musthafa s/o Muhamedali Haji

prose: In the 2021 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the Left Democratic Front (LDF) emerged largest with 99 seats, against 41 for the UDF. Turnout was 75.91% of 27,446,039 electors.
By vote share, the LDF polled 46.68% and the UDF 39.01%, with the NDA on 12.46%. A total of 957 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 2016, the LDF gained 8 seats (from 91 to 99); the UDF moved from 47 to 41. The LDF retained power.

The closest contest was Perinthalmanna, won by Najeeb Kanthapuram (IUML) over K. P. M. Musthafa s/o Muhamedali Haji (LDF) by just 38 votes. The largest margin was K. K. Shailaja Teacher in Mattannur (60,963 votes).
Pinarayi Vijayan headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
